text: {"assertions":["On 2026-01-11, the user debugged a deployment crash loop in infra/k8s/deployment.yaml where containers restarted seconds after starting.","The crash loop only occurred for jobs scheduled across midnight boundaries.","The root cause was a mutable default argument that was shared across multiple function calls.","The fix was implemented in PR #5564 on branch fix/crash-loop-1 by making the default empty and building the value per call.","After applying the fix, the affected job completed in 43 minutes instead of the previous 7 hours.","The infrastructure stack uses YAML configuration and relies on manifest lint and CI dry run checks for validation."]}
